solutionSql:
SELECT id, status
FROM shipment_scans_large
WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 50
  AND status LIKE 'del%'
ORDER BY id;

rules.howSolved: BETWEEN 1 AND 50 includes both ends, so ids 1 and 50 are considered.
status LIKE 'del%' keeps statuses that start with the lowercase prefix del.

ambiguities: 'begins with del' is read case-sensitively. An ILIKE reading would also match a capitalised 'Del' prefix, if any status had one.
notes: Ran on sample, nulls and boundary with no errors. The ticket's hint about index use was not checked with EXPLAIN.
